title: Chapter 592 - 592 Annihilation; Taking In A Disciple!
content:
Chapter 592 - 592 Annihilation; Taking In A Disciple!

Chapter 592 - 592 Annihilation; Taking in a Disciple!

592 Annihilation; Taking in a Disciple!

Many people in Hua Nation liked to travel to Japes, and Taro Yamamoto often heard Hua people speak.

Thus, he easily knew that Lin Fan was from Hua Nation.

Instantly, he became arrogant.

Taro Yamamoto pointed at the Heavenly Hound and said, “What pets do you need in the wilderness? Slaughter it and eat roasted meat!”

He seemed to think of the taste of roasted meat and could not help but swallow his saliva.

Lin Fan’s face had a weird look on it.

Slaughter the Heavenly Hound?

Eat its meat?

“Heavenly Hound, he wants to eat you,” Lin Fan said.

The Heavenly Hound did not know what Taro Yamamoto was talking about.

However, it understood Lin Fan’s words.

Instantly, the Heavenly Hound bared its teeth in a ferocious manner.

“Oh?” Taro Yamamoto laughed without fear. “The little guy seems quite fierce!

“I like those that resist!”

As he spoke, he took out the pistol at his waist and slowly approached the Heavenly Hound.

If the distance was too far, Taro Yamamoto could not guarantee that he could hit it.

If the Heavenly Hound escaped, he would not be able to eat meat.

…

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

Terence: [Can someone translate what this Japes man is saying?]

Fish: [Oh my god! He actually wants to eat the Heavenly Hound!]

Ruthless: [F*ck! He really wants to eat the Heavenly Hound. He even pulled out his gun.]

Little Thief in the Forest: [Eat the Heavenly Hound? Isn’t this courting death?]

Night Rain: [This person is Taro Yamamoto. He seems to have just obtained the Body Petrification Spell, which can turn part of his body into hard stone. He’s very powerful.]

Easy: [Powerful? No matter how powerful he is, can he compare to the Heavenly Hound or God Lin?]

…

In the live broadcast room in Japes.

Kawada: [Yamamoto seems to have met a Hua person.]

Jin Zhongyi: [It’s Lin Fan! It’s Hua Nation’s Lin Fan and the Heavenly Hound!]

Wood Dream: [It’s over. Yamamoto wants to eat the Heavenly Hound.]

Hashimoto Saburo: [Heavenly Hound! That monster that can become three meters tall?! Yamamoto, don’t be rash.]

Chong: [Yamamoto is about to make a move. However, he might not lose. Don’t forget that Yamamoto can has the petrification spell!]

…

Under everyone’s attention.

Taro Yamamoto and the Heavenly Hound were getting closer and closer.

The next moment, he grinned.

As soon as he finished speaking, he pulled the trigger.

It was also at this moment that the Heavenly Hound leaped up and stretched out its steel claws that were shining with a cold light.

Taro Yamamoto’s pupils suddenly constricted. Instinctively, his entire body petrified.

However…

Under the claws, the petrified Yamamoto Taro was like a bubble, directly shattering and turning into a pile of powder.

Silence!

The entire place was silent.

Suddenly, an emotionless voice sounded in the ears of the Japes people.

[Taro Yamamoto, the chosen one, has died. The pollution of Japes has increased by 20%.]

…

In the live broadcast room of Japes.

Wind Chimes: [No!]

Kudo: [Yamamoto is dead.]

Sand Gathering: [Pollution! So many impurities! The tap just let out stinky water.]

…

In the blink of an eye, two days had passed.

Over the past two days, Lin Fan had relied on his life in the Otherworld to obtain two special red packets. He had obtained 400 points of Constitution and 300 points of spiritual energy.

The sun was high in the sky, and a gentle breeze was blowing.

Lin Fan and the Heavenly Hound continued to roam the wilderness as usual.

In the distance, there was a tall forest that appeared very quiet.

At this moment, the birds that were originally perched on the trees seemed to have been frightened. They spread their wings and fled in unison, stirring up a pile of fallen leaves.

Then, a muffled sound came from the forest.

In the next moment…

A brownish-skinned foreign man wearing a white shirt and carrying a large backpack ran out of the forest in an extremely sorry state.

Behind him was a lion that was three meters tall and had a pair of sharp teeth that were two meters long. Its aura was extremely terrifying.

The brown-skinned man saw Lin Fan and shouted, “Go! Go! Go!”

Clearly, this was to remind Lin Fan to run.

When Lin Fan heard this, his impression of the brown-skinned man could not help but increase.

However, Lin Fan did not do as he was told. Instead, he continued to move forward at a steady pace.

As the lion got closer and closer to the brown-skinned man, it was about to slap him to the ground with its claws in the next moment…

Lin Fan pulled out the Star Meteorite Sword from his waist.

[Sword 1: Heaven Slaying Sword!]

A stream of light flashed.

The giant lion’s claws, and even the upper half of its body, were neatly slashed from the middle.

The giant lion that had been split into two fell straight to the ground, stirring up a cloud of dust.

Boiling hot blood spurted out wantonly.

The brown-skinned man was dumbfounded by this scene.

At that moment, an emotionless voice rang out.

[First to kill a level-two Megalodon Lion. You’ve obtained a level-two treasure chest.]

[First to kill a level-two Megalodon Lion. Hua Nation’s pollution has been reduced by 10%.]

Lin Fan did not care about the brown-skinned man who was in a daze. He opened the treasure chest.

[30 points of Constitution. Do you want to use them?]

Lin Fan did not care about these points and gestured for the Heavenly Hound to use them.

That was because a clear notification sounded in his mind.

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a special red packet—300 Constitution points.]

…

After the Heavenly Hound used 30 points of Constitution, the brown-skinned man regained his senses.

He quickly wiped away the blood that the giant lion had sprayed on his face and turned around to speak in English, “Are you from Earth?”

Lin Fan said in Chinese, “I’m from Hua Nation.”

The brown-skinned man became even more excited.

He stammered in the Hua language, “Hua Nation?!

“So you’re Hua, hohoho!

“Did you use kung fu just now?

“I knew that Hua Nation definitely had amazing martial arts!

“That’s amazing!”

As he spoke, he held the sword in his hand, waving and jumping around.

Lin Fan looked at his comical face and could not help but want to laugh.

At this moment, the brown-skinned man suddenly knelt on the ground and said, “My name is Sam Gilbeven, and I like Hua Nation’s kung fu the most. Please take me as your disciple.”

His tone was very sincere and serious.

However, it was this action that stunned Lin Fan.

Lin Fan did not know whether to laugh or cry. “I haven’t considered taking a disciple yet.”

“Master, I can endure hardships very well. I beg you, take me in as your disciple.” As Sam spoke, he knocked his head on the ground, causing his forehead to be covered in dust.

Lin Fan shook his head. “I really don’t want to take in a disciple. Also, you don’t have to call me Master. Just call me by my name. I’m Lin Fan.”

At this moment, Sam seemed to have thought of the plot of some Hua martial arts TV shows and hurriedly said, “I… I… Master, if you don’t agree, I won’t get up…”
